g.text: 1. Why Direct docker.io & Nested runsc Fail in Outer gVisor
2. Inner gvx systrap: Automatic EBUSY Fallback
3. Stub syscallThread Dispatch via Futex Loop (stub_amd64.s)
4. Inner gvx Subsystems Serving Nested docker:dind

text.tspan: iptables-nft -> Could not fetch rule set
overlay2 on outer gofer/9p rootfs -> EINVAL
(vfs fallback copies full rootfs on every RUN step)
(outer runsc already holds the single listener slot)
Step 2: Outer gVisor returns -EBUSY because the process
filter chain already has a seccomp user-notify listener
and binary-patched jmp rel32 trampolines + SYS_FUTEX
2. For stub address-space ops (mmap/munmap/clone), Sentry writes
sysno & args to read-only sentryMessage page
4. Stub syscall_loop wakes from FUTEX_WAIT, runs syscall,
writes stubMessage->ret, and wakes Sentry via FUTEX_WAKE
1 regular file on outer gofer; provides native overlayfs
Provides virtual docker0 bridge, veth pairs, and
Serves nested runc mount(proc, sysfs, cgroup2) and
pivot_root without calling outer runsc mount(2)
